description: Remove the test artifacts YOU created in this project — the templates, segments, workflows, webhook endpoints, and campaign drafts made through this MCP server, plus any contacts it auto-created while enrolling or tracking. It can only ever touch those: anything a human made through the dashboard or REST API is invisible to it, and resources you merely UPDATED (idempotent creates that matched an existing name) are never removed. Runs as a preview by default — call with { confirm: true } to actually delete. Use this at the end of an integration session so a production project isn't left holding your scaffolding.

confirm.description: Must be true to delete. Omitted or false returns a preview of exactly what would be removed.

kinds.description: Restrict cleanup to these kinds. Omit for everything this server created.

name: volanea_cleanup_test_data

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

items.description: Exactly what would be, or was, removed. Only artifacts this server created.

preview.description: True unless you confirmed — nothing was deleted.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
